scenarios.name: knowledge-base-query
scenarios.description: User searches a knowledge base for error information, drills into results, asks follow-up questions

turns.speak: search the knowledge base for rust error code E0308 mismatched types
show me the full article for the top result
does the article mention any common fixes for when this happens with closures
search the codebase for places where we have this same pattern and might hit this error

scenarios.name: file-operations-chain
scenarios.description: User chains file operations: read, analyze, transform, write — each step's output feeds the next

turns.speak: read the file src slash agent dot rs and show me all the public function signatures
which of those functions don't have doc comments yet
add doc comments to the three most important undocumented functions
now create a new file called API dot md in the docs directory with a summary of all public functions

scenarios.name: multi-tool-orchestration
scenarios.description: User orchestrates three tools in sequence to accomplish a task: grep → file read → git blame → report

turns.speak: find all places in the codebase where we call unwrap on a result type
for each one, show me the surrounding five lines of code so I can see the context
use git blame to find out who wrote each unwrap and when
create a report file listing each unwrap with its location, author, and date
now replace the three most dangerous unwraps with proper error handling

scenarios.name: error-recovery-with-fallback
scenarios.description: MCP tool call fails — agent tries alternative approach, fails again, asks user for direction

turns.speak: connect to the database and show me the list of active users
try reading from the read replica instead
that's also down, can you check if the database server is even running
ok it's not running, send an alert to the ops channel
also check when the database was last backed up and tell me the most recent backup time

scenarios.name: permission-escalation-flow
scenarios.description: User requests a dangerous operation — agent asks for confirmation, user provides it, operation proceeds with safeguards

turns.speak: delete all files matching star dot log in the logs directory
yes, I confirm, delete them all
wait, did it already delete them? show me what's left in the logs directory
good, now compress the remaining log files into a single archive

scenarios.name: data-pipeline-via-tools
scenarios.description: User builds an ad-hoc data pipeline: extract data with one tool, transform with another, load with a third — all via voice

turns.speak: extract all test result data from the last benchmark run
now parse that and show me only the entries where the real time factor is above zero point five
format that as a markdown table sorted from slowest to fastest
write the table to bench slash latest dot md and also send it to the performance slack channel

scenarios.name: config-management
scenarios.description: User manages project configuration via MCP tools — read, validate, update, validate again

turns.speak: show me the current project configuration from the mcp server
the default model path should be models slash moonshine dash tiny, update it
now validate the entire configuration against the schema
save the updated configuration and show me the diff from what it was before

scenarios.name: resource-inspection-chain
scenarios.description: User inspects MCP resources hierarchically: list → read specific → follow reference → read child

turns.speak: list all available resources on the mcp server
read the resource at path slash config slash server dot json
that config references a model file, check if that file actually exists on disk
it doesn't exist, show me what model files are actually available in the models directory
update the config to use the first available model file
